name: CV Job Match Report
description: Extract the complete text of a linked PDF resume and compare it with a job description to produce a structured report for human review.
requirements: A public direct PDF resume URL and complete job description; permission to send both to the configured services
PDF.co connection with PDF-to-text access; Open Flow sends the PDF URL to that document processor
Configured native Agent model; source uses gpt-4o-mini whose current default snapshot is scheduled for January14,2027 shutdown
Human review of extracted text,claims and job-related matching assessment before any employment decision
